title: ENHYPEN Drops Latest Instalment in ‘THE SIN’  Series With ‘BLISS’: Stream It Now
summary: THE SIN : BLISS is the K-pop group's eighth mini-album.
contentText:
Bliss out, ENHYPEN is back with six fresh tunes.

At the stroke of midnight, the K-pop heavyweights dropped THE SIN : BLISS , the group’s eighth mini album and the second instalment in the ongoing THE SIN series.

THE SIN : BLISS is ENHYPEN’s first release since HEESEUNG announced  that he would go his own way and pursue a solo career. Now a six-piece of Jake, Jay, Sunghoon, Sunoo, Jungwon and Ni-ki, the band recently completed the Latin American and United States legs of their BLOOD SAGA trek, their largest world tour to date .

ENHYPEN’s busy year has taken the group to Brazil, where they performed on late-night television program The Noite com Danilo Gentili ; and Mexico City for a 2026 FIFA World Cup celebration event at Campo Marte. Along the way, the group took part in San Diego Comic-Con 2026, where they introduced global audiences to “DARK MOON,” HYBE’s original story inspired by ENHYPEN’s narrative universe. The lads also gave blood — and their profiles — to the World Health Organization (WHO) campaign in celebration of World Blood Donor Day on June 14. 

Up next, BLOOD SAGA tour dates in the United Kingdom and Europe from February through March 2027, including stops in Italy, France, The Netherlands and Germany.

Prior to the release of THE SIN : BLISS , the group landed nine titles on the Billboard 200, including six top 10 appearances — MANIFESTO : DAY 1  (No. 6 in 2022),  DARK BLOOD  (No. 4, 2023),  ORANGE BLOOD  (No. 4, 2023),  ROMANCE : UNTOLD  (No. 2, 2024),  DESIRE : UNLEASH  (No. 3, 2025), and  THE SIN : VANISH  (No. 2, 2026).

Stream THE SIN : BLISS and check out the BLOOD SAGA 2027 world tour dates and venues below.
